{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Sensors: begin jamming. Tactical: raise shields and prepare to fire ion cannons. Standby the tractor beams and boarding shuttle; they will deploy at mark plus thirty seconds.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Urias Xhaxin]]|<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>}}
'''Boarding shuttles''' were a specialized type of [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. Used by military, [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], and [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] forces, boarding shuttles were designed to deliver [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] to an enemy vessel during a boarding action. The [[Katarn-class boarding shuttle|''Katarn''-class boarding shuttle]] was used by privateers and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="PP" />
